question: What happens if one wrongly fixates on the dependent nature of faculties?
premises: Limited faculties are perishable and dependent on the Lord.
One may ascertain this in a way that binds.
Such certainty makes one partake in samsara.
inference: A one-sided certainty about dependence can itself become a binding samsaric conviction.
plain_english: If one ascertains these faculties only as perishable and dependent on the Lord, one sinks into a certainty that cuts one off into participation in samsara.
